question: # of views of MrBeast video week 1?
resolution_criteria:
This market will resolve according to the number of views the next YouTube video posted by MrBeast after this market's creation gets in the first 7 days after being posted.

If MrBeast does not post a YouTube video by August 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to the lowest range bracket.

If the reported value falls exactly between two brackets, this market will resolve to the higher range bracket.

The resolution source for this is MrBeast's YouTube channel (https://www.youtube.com/@MrBeast), specifically the 'views' counter for the described video.

Note: This market refers to MrBeast's next video posted. Shorts, previews, or other videos released other than the referenced video will not be considered.

# MrBeast next-video week-1 views: research as of 2026-08-06

The main point: the last four main-channel videos got about 37M, 50-60M and 63.5-64M in their first week, plus one I could not pin down, all below the 70-110M typical earlier in 2026. The newest one, a charity video, was the lowest.

## 1. Resolution source
- I did not fetch the YouTube channel page (youtube.com/@MrBeast) directly, so I have no live counter reading. The Polymarket markets in this series name that same channel page as the resolution source. [Polymarket](https://polymarket.com/event/of-views-of-mrbeast-video-week-1-20260706143021531)
- Main-channel uploads in 2026 have come every other Saturday: May 2, May 16, May 30, Jun 13, Jun 27 and Jul 25. Jul 11 was skipped. On that cadence the next upload would be expected around Sat Aug 8, which fits the ~Aug 15 resolution date. [videohighlight](https://videohighlight.com/channel/@mrbeast)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question as of Aug 6. I found no confirmed main-channel upload between Jul 25 and Aug 6.
- 2026-08-01: MrBeast posted a TeamWater one-year update video. I could not confirm whether it was a main-channel long-form upload. It is not in the main-channel upload list I found, and it came out before this market was likely created. [Dexerto](https://www.dexerto.com/youtube/mrbeast-reveals-what-teamwaters-40m-actually-built-one-year-later-3393859/), [win.gg](https://win.gg/mrbeast-gives-teamwater-update-calls-out-adin-ross/)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-08-01: The TeamWater anniversary update came after criticism, including from Adin Ross, that he had not given updates. [win.gg](https://win.gg/mrbeast-gives-teamwater-update-calls-out-adin-ross/)
- 2026-07-30: FiercePharma reported that the Jul 25 charity video "I Granted 100 Kids Their Biggest Wish!" (made with Stand Up To Cancer and Amgen, featuring LeBron and The Rock) had over 30M views. [FiercePharma](https://www.fiercepharma.com/marketing/youtuber-mrbeast-welcomes-amgen-channel-research-awareness-video-kicking-pediatric-cancer)
- Late July: during his wedding week, MrBeast was still the #1 YouTube channel, with 870.5M weekly views across the whole channel. [theatdb](https://www.theatdb.com/news/top-50-most-viewed-youtube-channels-worldwide-week-of-07262026)
- 2026-07-21/22: He married Thea Booysen on Necker Island and said there would be no wedding video. [Dexerto](https://www.dexerto.com/youtube/mrbeast-reveals-first-wedding-photo-after-refusing-to-turn-ceremony-into-content-3389780/)
- 2026-07-11: He skipped the scheduled upload, posting on X: "No upload today, may or may not be getting married." [Dexerto](https://www.dexerto.com/youtube/mrbeast-teases-wedding-with-girlfriend-thea-booysen-after-breaking-upload-schedule-3385394/)

## 4. Base rates (first-week views, from resolved Polymarket brackets)
- Jul 25 "100 Kids" charity video: 37-37.5M. This settled both the <40M bracket of the Jul 6 market, which had the same brackets as this question, and the 37-37.5M bracket of the smaller-strikes market. [Polymarket](https://polymarket.com/event/of-views-of-mrbeast-video-week-1-smaller-strikes-20260731134307600), [Polymarket](https://polymarket.com/event/of-views-of-mrbeast-video-week-1-20260706143021531)
- Jun 27 "Survive 30 Days Chained To A Stranger": I could not find its week-1 figure. A tracker showed 85.2M total views as of about Aug 9, roughly six weeks after upload. [communitrics](https://videostats.communitrics.com/mrbeast)
- Jun 13 "50 YouTube Legends Fight For $1,000,000": 50-60M, from the Jun 8 market. Its day-1 views were 25-30M. [Polymarket](https://polymarket.com/event/of-views-of-mrbeast-video-week-1-20260608162814370), [Polymarket day 1](https://polymarket.com/event/of-views-of-next-mrbeast-video-on-day-1-20260608161931822)
- May 30 "7 Days Stranded in The Arctic": 63.5-64M. It had about 90.1M total views by Jun 30. [Polymarket](https://polymarket.com/event/of-views-of-mrbeast-video-week-1-smaller-strikes-20260605142213626), [Tubefilter](https://www.tubefilter.com/2026/06/30/top-5-branded-videos-mrbeast-freddy-schramm-nick-digiovanni-2-2/amp/)
- Apr 4 "50 Streamers Fight for $1,000,000": about 80.6M (80-81M bracket). [Polymarket](https://polymarket.com/event/of-views-of-mrbeast-video-week-1-smaller-strikes)
- Earlier 2026 markets resolved at 70-80M and 90-100M. [Polymarket](https://polymarket.com/event/of-views-of-next-mrbeast-video-on-week-1-963), [Polymarket](https://polymarket.com/event/of-views-of-next-mrbeast-video-on-week-1-883)
- Trend: first-week views fell from 70-100M in early 2026 to the 50-64M range in May and June. The July charity video got about 37M. Charity videos have historically done worse than challenge videos. [Dexerto](https://www.dexerto.com/youtube/mrbeast-responds-after-latest-charity-project-becomes-worst-performing-video-3029513/)
- Channel monthly gains (vidIQ): May +6.91B, June +5.26B, July +3.3B views. [vidIQ](https://vidiq.com/youtube-stats/channel/@mrbeast/)
- Variation between consecutive videos is large: roughly 15-30M up or down from one video to the next.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Polymarket runs this market as "# of views of MrBeast video week 1? (Aug. 3, 2026)", which launched Aug 3. I did not get a dated price snapshot from before the forecast deadline, so I have no reliable current odds to report. [Polymarket](https://polymarket.com/event/of-views-of-mrbeast-video-week-1-20260803174219757)
- I did not find this question on Manifold or Kalshi, or any expert forecasts for it.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- The next biweekly upload would fall around Sat Aug 8. How the video does in its first 24-48 hours will be the strongest signal. Day-1 views for recent videos ran about 25-37M.
- What kind of video it is matters. Big challenge or competition videos have done 50-80M+ in week 1, and charity videos about 37M.
- If no video is posted by Aug 31, 11:59 PM ET, the market resolves to <40M.
- Polymarket usually opens day-1 and "smaller strikes" side markets once a video is released, which will give in-progress pricing.
